verdict.rationale: Mirrors is a context-correction and observability layer for developers' own production agents, not an agent or LLM client that calls tools itself. The docs state that "your app keeps control of its model calls and tools," so plugging MCP servers into Mirrors to use their tools does not fit this kind of product. Editing a tool description or schema inside the user's agent is a different capability and does not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
